description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs chain_walk: 'if bc.as_ref().map(|b| b.ca) != Some(true)' — idiomatic at MSRV 1.73: 'if !bc.as_ref().is_some_and(|b| b.ca)'. The as_ref() is necessary since bc is used again in the pathLenConstraint check below. Rewrite: 'if !bc.as_ref().is_some_and(|b| b.ca) { return Err(Error::NotCA { index: i }); }'
title: bc.as_ref().map(...) != Some(true) should use is_some_and (MSRV 1.73)
